packageRules.description: Patch/minor devDependencies merge themselves once the required checks pass (0.x excluded: minors there may break)
Patch/minor devDependencies (0.x excluded, they stay separate) come as one weekly PR: fewer PRs, fewer CI runs. The groups below (tauri, nx, playwright) still win for their packages
Tauri JS packages and Rust crates must stay on matching versions
Nx is upgraded with `nx migrate` (it rewrites code); Renovate only flags it on the Dependency Dashboard
playwright and @playwright/test must resolve to one version: they share the downloaded browsers
pnpm is pinned both in package.json packageManager and in the workflows' pnpm/action-setup version; bump both in one PR
Hold WebdriverIO at 9 until @serenity-js/webdriverio supports 10 (its peer range is ^9; v10's default strictSelectors makes Serenity's isPresent() throw on a missing element)
